name: Fast Chicken 43
author: lenin55
description: Pill teal toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, opacity becomes 0.04, opacity becomes 0.16. Clicking it toggles it: right becomes -10px, background-color changes from #000000 to #85b8b7, background-color changes from #000000 to #018786. On focus, opacity becomes 0.12, opacity becomes 0.16.
